title: COR-328: Add User-Level Hooks Config With Project-Level Overrides
description: Adds event-based host command hooks loaded from ~/.ngramx.yaml, .ngramx/config.yaml, and optional hooks: in ngramx.yml, with deep-merge overrides for onWorktreeCreate and onEnvironmentUp.

test_plan.description: Unit tests for merge, loader, and runner
User-level onWorktreeCreate hook runs after worktree
steps: Create ~/.ngramx.yaml with hooks.onWorktreeCreate containing a harmless command such as echo READY-{ticket}
Run ngramx worktree <ticket> (or reuse an existing worktree flow)
Confirm the hook section appears in output and the command ran after the worktree is ready

test_plan.description: Project override replaces the matching user event list
steps: Keep a user onWorktreeCreate hook that echoes USER
Add .ngramx/config.yaml with onWorktreeCreate that echoes PROJECT
Confirm only the PROJECT hook runs for that event
Run ngramx up in a project
Confirm the hook runs after a successful start
